target_customer: Educators and social media creators (mostly in India) with a following who pay to run their own branded mobile app and website for courses and content
problem: Creators and educators depend on YouTube and social platforms that own the audience. AppX gives them their own app and website to sell courses, memberships and live classes without coding.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for creators, plus later stakes in creator ventures (divested in 2025)
product_category: No-code creator and edtech app and website builder

founders.name: Sameer Sadana
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as edtech SaaS entrepreneur. Brainup Studios detail from a yespress profile seen in search results, not opened. Education not found.

founders.name: Anuj Gupta
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder by Entrepreneur India (Jan 2022); a profile lists him as former CTO. Not on the YC page.

competitors.name: Classplus
competitors.what: White-label app and commerce platform for coaching centres, tutors and creators in India
competitors.traction_then: not stated in the sources opened
competitors.funding_then: Series C of about $65M led by Tiger Global, June 2021

technical_complexity.rationale: Templated white-label apps and websites with video, payments and DRM; mostly standard engineering with app store publishing overhead.

defensibility.rationale: Creators publish apps with their own audience, giving some switching cost, but many similar white-label tools exist and features are copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found of incumbents buying or copying it; AppX bought Superpage in Jan 2022 and later left creator ventures in 2025.

market_need_then: Indian edtech and creator economy were booming in 2020 and 2021 with heavy funding; creators wanted ownership of audiences beyond YouTube. The company's own framing cites a $100B creator market (Jan 2022).

branding.domain_note: Uses appx.co.in, not a .com; an unrelated AI app builder also uses the AppX name.

identity.voice_and_tone: Upbeat, direct, creator-focused calls to action such as 'Take the Leap Today' (company site)

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself; generic app-themed name shared with other products.

pivots.from: Investing in and running creator-led education ventures alongside SaaS
pivots.why: Reported conflict of interest with creator customers (Tribune India and others)

outcome_analysis: AppX is active. It raised about $1.3M seed in January 2022 led by Y Combinator, acquired Superpage that month, and reports thousands of creators on its platform. In April 2025 it exited stakes in educational YouTube channels to focus on B2B. Indian edtech funding fell hard from 2022, and the company has not publicly raised again, so growth seems bootstrapped.
notes: Seed reported as $1.3M by Entrepreneur India, Free Press Journal and Business Standard; MarketScreener says INR 90M. CB Insights and Caplight total $1.43M (unverified). Traction figures on the company site are inconsistent (10,000 vs 15,000 creators). Competitors list is limited to one dated source; Graphy and Teachable are named by later comparison pages only. Education and prior employers for Gupta not found.
